title: What it feels like to work with Mythos
summary: An article sharing the practical experience and insights gained from working with Mythos, an AI agent system, describing the workflow, challenges, and real-world implications of delegating tasks to autonomous agents.
problem_solved: Provides a firsthand account of what it's actually like to work with AI agents in practice, beyond theoretical discussions.
why_valuable: Offers authentic, experience-based insights into human-AI collaboration workflows, helping readers understand the practical realities of AI agent systems.
